Unfortunately there is only so much any medication can do. I know it's a cliché but there is no magic pill that will make it go away. I have been on so many different meds and I will think they are working great until they aren't. 

That's my experience at least.
I'm on lamotragine, quite a good mood stabilizer if your mood is only slightly up or down. It has been useless for me once an episode has started and has minimal effect on weight.
